item.title: המיליארדר בכפכפים שעומד מאחורי נשק ה-AI המתקדם שמכה באיראן
item.description: הוא רק בן 33, מסתובב עם מכנסיים קצרים וחולצות הוואי וכבר שווה 3.5 מיליארד דולר. פאלמר לאקי, מייסד אנדוריל, אחד הסטארטאפים הביטחוניים הבולטים במלחמה עם איראן, מגשים פיתוחים צבאיים שראו עד היום רק בסרטי אקשן: מטוס קרב ללא טייס, רחפן "מתאבד" והדור הבא של ה-AI בשדה הקרב. הוא מגדיר...

item.title: Kamenei's luxury London homes purchased with loan from Israeli-British-owned company
item.description: Shomrim investigation: In 2013, Iran's new supreme leader purchased a luxury mansion and 12 houses on 'Billionaires' Avenue' in London; a loan of 36 million pounds was financed by an investment company owned by two brothers born in Ramat Gan

item.title: Iranian drone boats attack oil tankers near Iraq as Gulf shipping disruptions grow | Watch
item.description: After the IRGC vowed not to let 'a single liter of oil' leave the Middle East, sea drones hit two tankers in Iraqi waters, killing one crew member; three cargo ships fired on near Strait of Hormuz, another attack reported near UAE port

item.title: ‘If a nuclear Iran took the Strait of Hormuz, who would control the world’s oil?’
item.description: Israeli Ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter argues the US-Israeli campaign aims to stop Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons, exporting terrorism and gaining leverage over global energy routes

item.title: UN Security Council approves resolution condemning Iran’s attacks against Gulf States
item.description: Bahrain's proposal, condemning Iran's attacks on the Gulf states, was passed by a majority of 13 votes, with Russia - one of Iran's main allies - and China choosing not to use their veto power; resolution also backed by 135 UN member states

item.title: Hezbollah, Iran continue launching coordinated barrages on northern, central Israel; sirens triggered in Eilat
item.description: Hezbollah and Iran continued coordinated rocket and missile barrages on northern and central Israel, targeting the Galilee, Haifa, the Sharon and Gush Dan, as drone alerts sounded in the Golan and Galilee Panhandle, and sirens were reported in Eilat

item.title: Report: Extent of new Iranian supreme leader’s injuries revealed
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei, who has not appeared publicly since the war began, reportedly suffered a fractured foot, facial cuts and bruising around one eye in the opening-day strike that killed his father, while Iranian officials insist he remains safe and active

item.title: Israel eyes African forward base to bring war to Houthis’ doorstep
item.description: Israeli officials reportedly surveyed Somaliland’s coast for a possible forward base that could support intelligence gathering and operations against Yemen’s Houthis, deepening ties after Israel’s recognition of the breakaway territory

item.title: תופעת המדינה כמלון: מוסר של תיירים
item.description: אלה שבכל מלחמה או מבצע שבים ודורשים אסטרטגיית יציאה מיידית, הם כמעט תמיד אלו שילדיהם לא יצטרכו לחיות בטווח האש של המחדל הבא

item.title: 3 חורים גדולים בגג הבטון ב"טלקאן 2": צה"ל הפציץ את האתר הרגיש באיראן
